Text:
# MEDIASTINITIS

Mediastinitis occurs after cardiothoracic procedures or less commonly after esophageal perforation.

# _______________________________________________________________________________

References:
Mandell chapter: Principles and Practice of Infectious Diseases.
Therapy:
## Treatment AFTER CARDIOTHORACIC SURGERY

Preferred:
[Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h R <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R](orz-set-abx-cefepime-2gm-iv-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)
< OR >
[Piperacillin/tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h R <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R](orz-set-abx-pip-taz4-5gm-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro-vanco15mg-kg)

Alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
[Levofloxacin 750 mg IV q24h R <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R](orz-set-abx-levo-750mg-iv-q24h-and-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)

## Treatment AFTER ESOPHAGEAL PERFORATION OR RUPTURE

Mixed aerobic/anaerobic infection is often present.

Preferred:
[Ampicillin-sulbactam 3 gm IV q6h R](psjizid-ampicillin-sulbactam-3gm-iv-q6h)

Alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
[Levofloxacin 750 mg IV q24h R,DI <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q12h DI](orz-set-abx-levofloxacin-750mg-iv-and-metro-500mg-iv-q12h)
